name: valid-guide
why: Positive control: a gate that rejects everything must fail.

name: missing-source
why: Copy from a file that no archive or earlier step provides.

name: escape-destination
why: Destination resolves outside the game directory.

name: unknown-action
why: Instruction action the installer does not support must stop, not be skipped.

name: missing-dependency
expect: Required dependency is absent from the guide
why: Selected component depends on a component the guide does not contain.

name: restriction-conflict
why: Two selected components restrict each other.
